intro: Spindrift Grapefruit is a refreshing sparkling water option on the [CAVA Drinks Menu](/menu/drinks) that delivers authentic citrus flavor with just 17 calories. Made with real grapefruit juice and sparkling water, this beverage offers a clean, natural taste without artificial sweeteners or flavors. It is the perfect light accompaniment to any meal from the [full CAVA menu](/), providing a zesty, bubbly refreshment that complements Mediterranean flavors beautifully.
priceCalories: Priced between $2.95 and $3.25, Spindrift Grapefruit contains only 17 calories per serving with 4g of carbohydrates, 0g of protein, and 0g of fat. This makes it one of the lowest-calorie drink options available at CAVA, ideal for health-conscious diners. The minimal calorie content allows you to enjoy a flavorful beverage without impacting your nutritional goals when building your custom bowl or pita.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets Spindrift Grapefruit apart is its commitment to real ingredients. Unlike most sparkling waters that use natural flavors or essences, Spindrift uses actual squeezed grapefruit juice, giving it an authentic taste and subtle sweetness. The brand is known for its transparency, with only two simple ingredients creating a beverage that tastes like fresh fruit. This clean ingredient list aligns perfectly with CAVA's Mediterranean-inspired philosophy of wholesome, quality ingredients.
nutritionFacts: Each can of Spindrift Grapefruit contains 17 calories, 4g of carbohydrates (from real fruit juice), 0g of protein, and 0g of fat. With no added sugars, artificial sweeteners, or preservatives, it is a naturally low-calorie refreshment option. The drink is suitable for various dietary preferences and can be tracked easily using the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) when planning your complete meal macros.
whatsInside: Spindrift Grapefruit contains just two simple ingredients: sparkling water and real grapefruit juice. There are no artificial flavors, essences, natural flavors, or sweeteners added. The subtle sweetness and tart citrus notes come entirely from the squeezed grapefruit juice. This minimal ingredient list makes it an excellent choice for those seeking transparency in their beverages and aligns with clean eating principles valued by CAVA diners.
tasteLike: Spindrift Grapefruit delivers an authentic, tart citrus flavor with natural sweetness from real fruit juice. The taste is crisp and refreshing with pronounced grapefruit notes that are neither too bitter nor artificially sweet. The sparkling water provides a satisfying effervescence that enhances the citrus experience. It tastes like freshly squeezed grapefruit with bubbles, offering a genuine fruit flavor that differs from typical flavored sparkling waters.
customize: While Spindrift Grapefruit comes pre-packaged and cannot be customized directly, you can enhance your beverage experience by pairing it strategically with items from the [CAVA Dressings Menu](/menu/dressings) or [CAVA Sides Menu](/menu/sides). Consider it as a palate cleanser between bites of rich dips and spreads. The citrus notes can complement spicy or savory dishes, making your overall dining experience more balanced and refreshing.
pairsWell: Spindrift Grapefruit pairs exceptionally well with rich, savory items from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains) like grilled chicken or spicy lamb meatballs. The citrus acidity cuts through creamy dips like hummus and tzatziki beautifully. It also complements Mediterranean spices and herb-forward dishes. For a complete refreshment, pair it with Classic Lemonade or Blueberry Lavender for those sharing meals who want variety in their drink selections.
healthyChoice: At only 17 calories with no added sugars or artificial ingredients, Spindrift Grapefruit is an excellent healthy beverage choice. It provides hydration with a hint of natural fruit flavor, making it easier to avoid high-calorie sodas. The real grapefruit juice offers trace amounts of vitamin C and antioxidants. This drink supports wellness goals without sacrificing taste, fitting perfectly into balanced Mediterranean-style eating patterns that CAVA promotes.
howToOrder: To order Spindrift Grapefruit at CAVA, simply add it to your meal when selecting beverages at the counter or through the online ordering system. It is available at all [CAVA Locations](/locations) that carry the full drinks menu. Specify your preference when building your bowl or pita, and the staff will include it with your order. You can also reference the [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu) if you have specific dietary concerns.
vsAlternatives: Compared to Classic Lemonade (260-360 calories), Spindrift Grapefruit offers a dramatically lower-calorie option at just 17 calories while still providing authentic fruit flavor. Unlike Blueberry Lavender (140-190 calories), which contains more sugar, Spindrift uses only real fruit juice for subtle sweetness. While lemonades offer bolder sweetness, Spindrift provides a more sophisticated, tart refreshment that appeals to those preferring less sugary beverages without artificial ingredients.
whoShouldTry: Spindrift Grapefruit is perfect for health-conscious diners seeking flavorful hydration without excess calories or sugar. Citrus lovers who appreciate authentic grapefruit flavor will enjoy its genuine taste. Those avoiding artificial sweeteners, natural flavors, or additives will appreciate the clean ingredient list. It is also ideal for anyone following low-calorie, low-carb, or diabetic-friendly eating plans while dining at CAVA and wanting more than plain water.
worthTrying: Spindrift Grapefruit is absolutely worth trying for anyone seeking a refreshing, low-calorie beverage made with real ingredients. At under $4, it offers excellent value for a premium sparkling water featuring authentic fruit juice. The clean taste and minimal calories make it a guilt-free indulgence that enhances your CAVA dining experience. Whether you are a regular CAVA customer or first-time visitor, this drink exemplifies quality and transparency in beverage choices.
